main_result.statement: An actual dense three-good chart cannot have embedded S=C[r,q], A_s=C[r,t,z]_h, q=a(r)z-H(r,t), with a root r0 of a surviving h, deg_t H(r0,t)>=2, and both projected goods complex affine-linear forms in r,t,z.
main_result.proof: For projection rank two, a nonconstant critical polynomial F over C(r,q) supplies a common zero of the two-row Jacobian minors at a point untouched by invariant denominators. A divisor-Laurent comparison proves nonconstancy even for arbitrary higher-degree base-dependent H and multiple roots of a. Rank-one projections violate whole generic-line generation or divisor noncollapse.
main_result.exact_formula: D=a*g_q-H_t*f_q; I=a'*(q+H)-a*H_r+alpha*a*H_t-beta*a^2; F=I*D+a^2*g_r-a*H_t*f_r. Original identity f_q*F-(f_q*I+a*f_r)*D=-a^2*J, J=f_r*g_q-f_q*g_r.
main_result.dependencies: Actual139 localized inverse and whole generic line;134 invariant-divisor good-ring injection;147 noncollapse. Simultaneous embedded triangular base and affine projected-coordinate placement are extra hypotheses, not inferred from those results.
main_result.scope: No last-coordinate time-degree bound or constant selected-speed assumption. Includes arbitrary polynomial base dependence H with a nonlinear surviving specialization, but not arbitrary nonlinear reorientations of the projected goods.

companion_results: Fixed projection lemma: for q=pz-H(y), deg H>=2, all rational independent speeds f,g in C(p,q) produce a proper two-row Jacobian minor ideal after any invariant localization. This elementary special-case proof is preserved separately.

W=u line-family classification: in the actual intercept coordinates, if all three speeds lie in C[p,a(p)z-H(p,y)] with a nonlinear H-specialization at a root of a, nilpotence of their original Jacobian forces (constant,g0(p),h0(p)). The speed field has rank at most one. It cannot be the desired dense rank-two frame.

The full-kernel and degree-d residue-field calculation in the companion note remains limited to its P(y) model; arbitrary H(p,y) can enlarge the kernel at other collapsing roots. The generalized speed-membership exclusion makes no such kernel assertion.
